gloss: going in and out; traffic; access

definitions.gloss: going in and out; entering and exiting
definitions.explanation: The act of going in and coming out of a place.
The flow of people or vehicles entering and leaving a place.
Variation or discrepancy, especially in numbers or amounts.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}は{出入|でい}りが{自由|じゆう}だ。
examples.english: This building allows free entry and exit.

examples.japanese: {出入|でい}りの{多|おお}い{店|みせ}だ。
examples.english: This store has a lot of foot traffic.

examples.japanese: {収入|しゅうにゅう}と{支出|ししゅつ}の{出入|でい}りを{記録|きろく}する。
examples.english: I record the fluctuations in income and expenses.

examples.japanese: {出入|でい}り{口|ぐち}はどこですか。
{部外者|ぶがいしゃ}の{出入|でい}りは{禁止|きんし}されている。
examples.english: Entry and exit by outsiders is prohibited.

examples.japanese: {出入|でい}りを{管理|かんり}する。
{夜間|やかん}の{出入|でい}りにはカードキーが{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: A key card is required for entry and exit at night.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}の{出入|でい}りが{激|はげ}しい。
{出入|でい}りの{少|すく}ない{店|みせ}だ。
examples.english: It's a store with little foot traffic.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{出入|でい}りに{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please watch out for vehicles coming and going.

examples.japanese: {出入|でい}りの{業者|ぎょうしゃ}。
examples.english: Suppliers who regularly come and go.

examples.japanese: {計算|けいさん}に{出入|でい}りがある。
examples.english: There's a discrepancy in the calculation.

examples.japanese: {金額|きんがく}に{出入|でい}りがあった。
examples.english: There was a fluctuation in the amount.

examples.japanese: {在庫|ざいこ}の{出入|でい}りを{確認|かくにん}する。
{売|う}り{上|あ}げの{出入|でい}りが{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: There's a large fluctuation in sales.

examples.japanese: {出入|でい}りの{激|はげ}しい{職場|しょくば}だ。
examples.english: It's a workplace with high turnover.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
・{出|で} (going out) + {入|い}り (coming in)
・A compound noun combining opposite actions

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{出入|でい}り{口|ぐち} (entrance/exit)
・{出入|でい}り{禁止|きんし} (entry/exit prohibited)
・{出入|でい}りが{激|はげ}しい (busy with traffic)

SIMILAR COMPOUND WORDS:
・{出|しゅつ}{入|にゅう} (formal reading: しゅつにゅう) - more formal, used in documents
・{入|い}り{出|で} (less common reverse order)

The casual reading でいり is standard; the formal on'yomi reading しゅつにゅう is used in official contexts like {出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}{管理|かんり} (immigration control).
